meta.title: 6月销量分析 燃油车篇
meta.topic: 燃油车销量与购车分析

scenes.context: 26年6月是行业分水岭，油车向新能源转型定于此月；行业整体经济形势不好。
sentences: 我们今天分析6月销量的最后一篇。
Today is the last piece of our June sales analysis.
sales analysis（销量分析）
这个月的销量其实是有一定指导意义的。
This month's numbers are quite telling.
telling（有指导意义的）
整体的经济形势不太好。
The overall economy isn't doing well.
economy（经济）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达指导意义
These numbers hint at where the industry is headed.
换种说法表达行业困境
Times are tough across the whole car industry.
scenes.speak: Today is the last piece of our June sales analysis. This month's numbers are quite telling — they hint at where the industry is headed, and the overall economy isn't doing well.

scenes.context: 奥迪 6 月没做太多让利，A6 7000 台、Q5 6000 台；豪华品牌卖不动先减量不降价。
sentences: 奥迪的A6历史的只卖到了7000台。
The Audi A6 only sold 7,000 units.
units（台）
大家要知道Q5只卖了6000台。
Keep in mind the Q5 only sold 6,000.
keep in mind（要知道）
任何一个豪华品牌当他卖不动的时候 想到的第一点永远是减量而不是降价。
When a luxury brand can't sell, it cuts volume first — not price.
cut volume（减量）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达销量下滑
Even the A6 dipped to just 7,000 units.
换种说法表达保价逻辑
Luxury brands protect the brand by shrinking supply.
scenes.speak: The Audi A6 only sold 7,000 units, and keep in mind the Q5 only sold 6,000. When a luxury brand can't sell, it cuts volume first — not price.

scenes.context: 奔驰 E 促销卖到 1 万台；丰田回暖、大众 8-20 万卖得好。
sentences: 奔驰E是卖到了一万台。
The Mercedes E-Class sold 10,000 units.
E-Class（E级）
丰田我觉得还是有一些回暖了。
Toyota seems to be picking up again.
pick up（回暖）
你大众是集中在就是20万以内吧。
Volkswagen dominates under 200k yuan.
dominate（主导）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达促销换量
Big discounts helped the E-Class hit 10,000.
换种说法表达品牌区间
VW's sweet spot is affordable midsize cars.
scenes.speak: The Mercedes E-Class sold 10,000 units after big discounts. Toyota seems to be picking up again, and Volkswagen dominates the under-200k-yuan segment.

scenes.context: 二线豪华普遍难过；国产推荐吉利、长安、奇瑞三家。
sentences: 二线豪华品牌日子不太好过。
Second-tier luxury brands are struggling.
struggling（艰难）
国产的燃油车 我其实基本就推荐三家。
For domestic fuel cars, I basically recommend three brands.
recommend（推荐）
吉利坐的车是普遍老百姓大众都能接受的车型。
Geely builds cars most people can accept.
accept（接受）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达二线困境
Mid-tier premium marques are barely holding on.
换种说法表达国产选择
For value, stick with Geely, Changan and Chery.
scenes.speak: Second-tier luxury brands are struggling. For domestic fuel cars, I basically recommend three brands — Geely builds cars most people can accept.

scenes.context: 燃油车占比降到 40%；8 月底问价、9-10 月出手；二手豪华车有性价比。
sentences: 燃油车现在占比是40%。
Fuel cars now make up 40 percent.
make up（占比）
你现在的第一个日期 我觉得先看八月底。
The first date to watch is the end of August.
watch（关注）
然后出手可能是在九月底或十月底。
Then pull the trigger in late September or October.
pull the trigger（出手）
paraphrase: 换种说法表达占比下降
Fuel cars have shrunk to four in ten sales.
换种说法表达出手时机
Ask about prices in August, buy in the fall.
scenes.speak: Fuel cars now make up 40 percent of the market. The first date to watch is the end of August, then pull the trigger in late September or October.

practice: This month's numbers are quite telling.
Luxury brands cut volume instead of price.
Toyota seems to be picking up again.
Pull the trigger in late September.
pitfalls: 以为降价就能救豪华品牌
降价伤害品牌且难恢复
区分 8-20 万与 20-30 万区间
大众强在 20 万内，丰田占更高价位
总量只剩原来 70% 左右
淡季与年底甩卖期更划算
shifts: 燃油车也有抄底与经典车型机会
豪华品牌靠减量保品牌价值
按 8 月问价、9-10 月出手的节奏规划
footer_notes: 来源：6月销量分析 燃油车篇（小红书，时长29分钟）
